description: R5 delegation execution-start reporting: ReasoningBackend implementations whose delegateTask body is NOT wrapped in runStartReportingDelegation. Every entry needs a reason. Decorators that only forward to a wrapped backend (which reports itself) and in-process doubles with no side effects belong here; a backend that dispatches to a provider never does. Gate: tests/delegation-start-reporting.test.ts.

exceptions.reason: Consumer, not a dispatcher: delegateTask runs the R5 failover guard (delegation-failover-guard.ts runGuarded), which opens its own execution tracker per attempt and forwards to the candidate backend's delegateTask.
Decorator: resolves the role's backend and forwards delegateTask to it unchanged; the resolved backend reports its own start.
Deterministic in-process stub: returns a canned string and has no side effects, so there is no start to report and an unmarked failure cannot double-execute anything.

Decorator: routes delegateTask through the configured AgentDispatcher, whose default strategy calls the wrapped base backend's own delegateTask (which reports its start); an alternate dispatcher's spawn is reported by spawnWithDelegationEnv.
Scenario-test decorator: forwards delegateTask to the in-scope fixture (side-effect-free canned answers) or to the real fallback backend, which reports its own start.
Conformance-probe double: spreads stubReasoningBackend (side-effect-free) and only overrides prompt() to fail; it never dispatches to a provider.
